name: Batik
description: Hand-drawn and hand-stamped batik cloth from Central Java's batik houses, using natural and traditional dye techniques passed down for generations.

name: Songket and Tenun
description: Songket and tenun ikat woven on traditional looms, many with metallic gold and silver supplementary threads, from weaving communities across the archipelago.

name: Kebaya
description: Traditional kebaya blouses in brocade, lace, and embroidered cotton, tailored in classic and modern cuts for everyday wear and formal occasions.

name: Accessories and Jewelry
description: A curated edit of jewelry and small accessories designed to complete a traditional or modern-heritage outfit.

name: Bag
description: Rattan, pandan, and woven bags handmade by artisan cooperatives in Bali and Central Java.

name: Jewelry
description: Rings, earrings, and necklaces made by small goldsmith workshops, blending traditional motifs with everyday wearability.

name: Plate
description: Ceramic and hand-painted plates made in small-batch pottery studios, each piece slightly one-of-a-kind.

name: Other Accessories
tagline: Small pieces, hard to categorize, easy to love
description: Fans, belts, hair pieces, and other handmade accessories that round out the collection.

name: Songket Palembang
description: Songket woven in and around Palembang, known for dense gold-wrapped supplementary weft and motifs tied to Malay court tradition.

name: Songket Padang
description: Songket from the Padang and greater Minangkabau region, with geometric and floral motifs distinct from Palembang's court style.

name: Tenun Indonesia Timur
description: Hand-tied and hand-woven ikat tenun from the islands of East Nusa Tenggara and neighboring regions, woven on backstrap looms.

name: Songket and Tenun Sumatra Utara
tagline: Ulos and songket from North Sumatra
description: Woven cloth from North Sumatra, including Batak ulos and local songket variants, each carrying its own ceremonial meaning.

name: Other Collections
tagline: A rotating edit beyond the usual categories
description: Curated pieces and small collections that don't fit neatly elsewhere — a home for one-off finds and new directions we're exploring.
